title: Decide whether re-running The Group's seed may overwrite the Space Home and page edits made since the last run

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: The seed calls itself idempotent, but each spaces upsert does preferences = coalesce(spaces.preferences,'{}') || excluded.preferences, and the seeded preferences carry pageDocs, profileLayout, pages, siteHero, siteFooter and profileData, which || replaces whole. The seed was regenerated in #3429, #3431, #3432 and #3466, so it is re-run; any edit to The Group's Home, chapter pages or Space-page layout between runs is silently lost (websiteEditor is not seeded, so the website survives). Ruling: write pageDocs, profileLayout and pages only when absent, or keep the overwrite and say so in the header.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('scripts/seed-the-group.sql','utf8');if(/\\|\\|\\s*excluded\\.preferences/.test(s)&&/idempotent/i.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-1016: the seed calls itself idempotent but replaces the Space pages and layout on every run');process.exit(1)}"
